notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator are counted separately because each is independently hinged and appears to be opened in sequence. Their closing actions occur within the sparsely sampled 320–328 interval, so the individual off timings are approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both hinged doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens a food-storage drawer left of the stove and a utensil/storage drawer right of the stove. The cabinet doors and both drawers are subsequently closed.
